enable_dag_steering_reason: GP-134: DAG steering parses latest_probability_dag.json each iter and prepends the highest-urgency watch_signal to the mutator prompt. Steers Lucky Newton away from log(n) vs log(log(n)) aliasing basin toward weaker DAG nodes (identifiability, secondary observable specificity).
persona: You are a skeptical quantitative reviewer studying an anonymous density ratio z(n) that appears to increase slowly with n. You know nothing about the origin of this sequence. You demand both a compressing fit AND a secondary observable: a mathematically distinct prediction your model makes beyond fitting the primary data. A model that only fits without predicting anything new is descriptive, not generative. You are a TOPOLOGY GENERATOR: provide a fit_declaration block only.

dimensions.name: Primary Fit Quality
dimensions.description: Does f(n) fit the visible evidence with residual below gate threshold? Does it generalize to holdout and farther-tail without divergence?

dimensions.name: Structural Derivation
dimensions.description: Does the thesis derive the functional form from specific data features? Are rivals named and excluded with evidence?

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: Does the thesis name a SECONDARY OBSERVABLE — a mathematically distinct prediction the model makes beyond fitting z(n)? The secondary observable must be: (a) computable from data or derivable from the model, (b) orthogonal to the primary fit (not a restatement of residual quality), (c) pre-committed with an expected value or range AND an evaluation method. Examples: a coefficient ratio under data perturbation, a prediction about a transformed observable, a relationship between parameters that constrains future data. A thesis that only fits z(n) without predicting anything else scores 0 on this dimension.

dimensions.name: Parsimony
dimensions.description: Is the model minimal? Fewer parameters preferred. Polynomial bloat penalized.

dimensions.name: Farther-Tail Prediction
dimensions.description: Does the model maintain accuracy at 4x-10x the visible range? Divergence at farther-tail is a structural failure, not a precision issue.

penalties: NO_SECONDARY: Any thesis that does not name a secondary observable scores 0 on Generative Yield (25% of total).
TRIVIAL_RESTATEMENT: A secondary observable that restates the primary fit (e.g., 'residual should be small at holdout') scores 0.
NAMED_IMPORT: Any model referencing a named mathematical constant or sequence by name scores 0 on Structural Derivation.

criteria.1_Primary_Fit: Does f(n) fit visible evidence with max normalized residual < 0.05?
criteria.2_Derivation: Does the thesis derive the form from >=3 specific (n, z) observations?
criteria.3_Generative_Yield: Does the thesis name a secondary observable with expected value/range AND evaluation method? Is the secondary prediction mathematically orthogonal to the primary fit?
criteria.4_Parsimony: Is the model minimal? k <= 4 parameters preferred.
criteria.5_Farther_Tail: Does the model hold at 4x-10x visible range without systematic drift?
